title: Phone: APD Watch Commander on Ext. 5501, Who Has Command?

caller.name: Sgt. Dana Ruiz
caller.label: Watch Commander, Alder Falls Police Department

callee.name: Patrol Lieutenant
callee.number: Mobile, patched via Wren County Communications
callee.label: Patrol Lieutenant, Sheriff's Office of Wren County

transcript.speaker: Patrol Lieutenant
transcript.text: Patrol Lieutenant, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: APD Watch Commander
transcript.text: Lieutenant, this is Sgt. Dana Ruiz, APD watch commander. Wren 14 just called me about your missing girl. That north gate road is inside our city limits, so if the truck went that way, it's on our ground.

transcript.speaker: APD Watch Commander
transcript.text: So, two questions. Who has command right now? And where do you want my officers to report?

transcript.speaker: Patrol Lieutenant
transcript.text: (Lieutenant answers: who holds command, and where APD reports.)

transcript.speaker: APD Watch Commander
transcript.text: Okay. I can send two officers right now, plus our detective from the child abuse team. They'll be on APD-1 unless you tell me otherwise.

transcript.speaker: APD Watch Commander
transcript.text: One more thing. Our drone crew is asking whether they should launch. That's my call, but I'd want the request to come through your command post, with the reason written down. What do you need from it, if anything?

transcript.speaker: Patrol Lieutenant
transcript.text: (Lieutenant answers: drone request, officers' channel, and how APD joins command.)

voiceStyles.APD Watch Commander: Man in his 50s, calm and brisk, a veteran police sergeant speaking fast but clearly, faint office radio chatter behind him
voiceStyles.Patrol Lieutenant: Live response from the Incident Commander player

instructorNote: This tests whether the IC formally takes command from Wren 14 and, within 20 minutes, names a command post at building level, such as the Fairgrounds Exhibit Hall B office. Under the written agreement between APD and the Wren County Sheriff's Office, the IC keeps command until unified command forms. The IC should invite APD into it and give APD officers a reporting point and a channel. Watch that any drone request goes through the IC with its reason recorded, while the launch stays APD's decision. Also check that the command arrangement is logged in CAD 26-081377.

citations.documentTitle: WCSO-OP-04: Critical Incident Command and Mutual Aid
citations.quote: The Incident Commander names a command post location, at building level (for example "Fairgrounds Exhibit Hall B office"), within 20 minutes of assuming command for any incident expected to last more

citations.documentTitle: WCSO-OP-04: Critical Incident Command and Mutual Aid
citations.headingPath: WCICMA › 5. Mutual aid and state help
citations.quote: Requests are made by the Incident Commander through the Communications Center, in this order: 1. Alder Falls Police Department, by phone to the APD watch commander, extension 5501 on the shared line.
